sources.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Monthly Retail Trade: Jewelry Stores (NAICS 44831), not seasonally adjusted, via FRED MRTSSM44831USN; monthly sales ÷ that year's monthly mean, averaged over 2017-2019. Census suppresses the jewelry line from March 2021 on ((S) in mrtssales92-present.xlsx, checked Nov 3, 2026), so this is the latest jewelry-specific pattern published. Cross-checked against the parent category (448, clothing and accessories stores) for 2023-2025: December 1.56× and November 1.12-1.16× in both 2019 and 2023-2025, so the holiday shape has not moved

Gupta Media, Meta (Facebook + Instagram) average CPM by month, 2024 and 2025; each month ÷ that year's monthly mean, averaged over the two years. Latest full years with a monthly series; 2026 only runs to September (AdKit worldwide medians) and a partial year cannot be normalized to an annual mean

note: Indexes are relative to an average month (mean 1.0). Applied as a prior for the month being planned; never used to calibrate or backtest, because one year of a brand's history cannot separate seasonality from everything else.
